g.text: loads the catalogue, aliases and fiber models once;

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start
font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a4a4a
font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #555555

font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a4a4a

g.text: tokens → modXNA backbone/sugar/base triplets; strand 2 reversed;
a linkage belongs to its 3′ nucleotide; ‘-’ = overhang or abasic site

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start
font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a4a4a

g.text: hybrids built on the strands that match their chemistry; repeat
phase fitted to the purine/pyrimidine pattern; sequence checks

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start
font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a4a4a

g.text: slot i mod k, moved by the screw operation ⌊i/k⌋ times; base swap
in the standard frame; O2′ added or removed; pucker and syn checks

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start
font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a4a4a

g.text: shared atoms kept; new atoms by local superposition; phosphorus rule
(PS1/PS2); ring closures relaxed; stereo, bond and contact checks

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start
font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a4a4a

g.text: chain A = strand 1, chain B = strand 2 (5′→3′); 5′ phosphate removed;
modified residues X01, X02, … or names chosen by the user

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start
font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a4a4a

g.text: from the unit tleap will match (Amber or modXNA), by superposition
anchored on the bonded atom; heavy atoms do not move

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start
font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a4a4a

g.text: 2′-OMe and MOE torsions scanned out of contacts (2.9 Å; 2.0 Å with H);
each chain sees the chains already turned

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start
font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a4a4a

g.text: flipped hybrids turned by Rx(180°), then centred;
O3′–P within 1.45–1.75 Å; inter-residue contacts < 2.2 Å
